2608.21941.title: Multimodal Prompt Learning with Irregular EHRs for Robust Monitoring of Critical Care Patients
2608.21941.paper_summary: Accurate assessment of patients in intensive care units (ICUs) is essential for timely clinical intervention and improved patient outcomes. Multimodal electronic health records (EHRs), including structured physiological time series and longitudinal clinical notes, provide complementary information for critical care prediction. However, in real-world clinical settings, individual modalities may be partially observed or entirely unavailable, resulting in substantial performance degradation for existing multimodal models. To address this challenge, we propose a multimodal prompt-learning framework for robust clinical prediction under diverse missing-modality scenarios. The proposed framework introduces four complementary types of prompts: generative prompts, missing-signal prompts, missing-type prompts, and temporal prompts. Generative prompts construct surrogate latent representations for unavailable modalities, while missing-signal prompts distinguish observed representations from generated ones. Missing-type prompts condition the model on different modality-availability configurations, whereas temporal prompts perform condition-specific aggregation over temporally encoded clinical sequences. Together, these prompts enable the model to capture missingness-aware intramodal dependencies and cross-modal interactions within a unified architecture. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method outperforms existing approaches across evaluation metrics on two missingness settings. Ablation and robustness analyses further verify the complementary contributions of the four prompt types and the effectiveness of the proposed framework for clinical prediction from incomplete multimodal EHR data.
2608.21941.paper_summary_zh: 準確評估重症監護病房（ICU）中的病人對於及時的臨床干預和改善病人結果至關重要。多模態電子健康紀錄（EHR），包括結構化的生理時間序列和縱向臨床筆記，為重症護理預測提供了互補的信息。然而，在現實臨床環境中，單一模態可能會部分觀察到或完全無法獲得，導致現有多模態模型的性能顯著下降。為了解決這一挑戰，我們提出了一種多模態提示學習框架，以實現多樣缺失模態場景下的穩健臨床預測。該框架引入了四種互補類型的提示：生成提示、缺失信號提示、缺失類型提示和時間提示。生成提示為不可用的模態構建替代潛在表示，而缺失信號提示則區分觀察到的表示和生成的表示。缺失類型提示使模型根據不同的模態可用性配置進行調整，而時間提示則對時間編碼的臨床序列進行條件特定的聚合。這些提示共同使模型能夠捕捉到缺失感知的內模態依賴性和跨模態互動，並在統一架構中實現。大量實驗表明，我們的方法在兩種缺失設定下的評估指標上超越了現有方法。消融和穩健性分析進一步驗證了四種提示類型的互補貢獻及所提出框架在從不完整多模態EHR數據中進行臨床預測的有效性。
